newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila Central Bank okays RCBC dividend.
newsitem.headline: Manila Central Bank okays RCBC dividend.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank has approved the proposal of Rizal Commercial Banking Corp (RCBC) to declare a 800-percent stock dividend, the Manila exchange said on Wednesday.

"The Central Bank has approved the bank's stock dividend in the amount of 3.191 billion pesos to stockholders of record as of date that will be fixed or determined by the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC)," the bourse said in an advisory to stock brokers.
RCBC A was last traded at 4,130 pesos on October 10 while its B shares closed at 1,500 on May 19 last year. RCBC shares have a face value of 100 pesos each.
